primary_metric: Flickr30k Karpathy validation mean bidirectional R@1

accuracy_hypotheses.statement: Within each parent architecture, merging after block 8 will retain at least as much validation retrieval accuracy as merging after block 6.
At each matched merge location, dual LoRA will outperform the strictly frozen-weight parent on validation retrieval accuracy.
No prior is assigned to whether either TokenShift location will match its corresponding existing no-merge parent in validation retrieval accuracy.

selection_rule: No candidate is promoted automatically. All four three-seed results, their paired parent comparisons, parameter counts and same-allocation latency measurements are reported for a separate frozen decision.
